messages:
maria-l: Heads-up — noticed a spike in audit events for kms:Decrypt across prod (us-west-2) around 2026-03-18 22:14 UTC. cc @raj @alyssa. Can we confirm if this was legit or tied to the RBAC change rolled last week?
raj: saw that, digging. sec-bot already flagged anomalous decrypt rate for key prod-kms-01. Link: https://sentry.internal/alert/9876 (internal)
alyssa: I pulled logs. There's a cluster of requests with principal service-account:infra-deployer@redwood that matched PR #1243 rollout window. But timestamps are slightly offset.
sec-bot: [alert] anomalous_kms_decrypt_rate detected for key=prod-kms-01 count=582 window=15m score=0.86
maria-l: can someone paste a sample audit event (redacted) — need actor, resource, request_id, and policy_evaluation fields.
jordan: here's one (redacted):
```json
{"event":"kms.decrypt","principal":"service-account:infra-deployer@redwood","resource":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/prod-kms-01","request_id":"req-0a1b2c3d","policy_eval":{"allowed":true,"matched_binding":"roles/kms.admin","actor_claims":{"sub":"svc:infra-deployer","roles":["deploy"]}}}
```
samir: policy change PR 1243 added temporary binding to group infra-ops for can-decrypt on prod-kms-01 — it was supposed to be scoped to staging only. I filed rollback but want to confirm timeline.
alyssa: timeline notes: PR merged 2026-03-18 21:59 UTC, config apply completed 22:01 UTC, spike starts 22:14 UTC. Also saw customer-facing audit schema missing 'policy_eval' for some older export events — that could affect customer inquiries.
maria-l: So likely human error in PR target. Action items: 1) Confirm all decrypts with request_id correlate to infra-deployer agents 2) Rollback binding if still present 3) Backfill customer audit events with policy_eval field for affected window.
raj: running query now to list unique principals and request_ids between 22:10-22:20 UTC; will post results in a sec.
sec-bot: deploy-bot posted: Deployment 1243 applied by alyssa at 22:01 UTC — job id deploy-1243 — link: https://ci.redwood/deploys/1243
jordan: query output (sample):
- service-account:infra-deployer@redwood (412 requests)
- user:alice@customercorp.com (3 requests)
- service:external-sync@partner (0 requests)
Seems dominated by infra-deployer.
maria-l: Good. samir, can you verify the KMS CMK rotation schedule? Could rotation correlate?
samir: CMK rotation was scheduled 03-20; no rotation at that time. Not related.
alyssa: For customer-facing audit exports, we need to ensure schema includes policy_eval and actor.identity fields. I'll open a follow-up to update the exporter and run backfill for 2026-03-18 22:00-22:30 UTC.
raj: Query results attached: top request_ids list -> req-0a1b2c3d, req-0a1b2c3e, req-0a1b2c3f... (snip). I'll correlate with deploy logs and escalate to SOC if any non-infra principals show up.
maria-l: Thanks. Short-term: rollback binding and notify affected customers proactively with event summary + audit snippet. Alyssa, can you draft the customer note? Keep it factual, include redacted events and mitigation.
alyssa: on it. Drafting now. Will include timeline, root cause (mis-scoped RBAC binding), mitigation steps, and how to verify via their audit exports.
sec-bot: incident-ticket #INC-2026-173 opened by raj. Priority P2.
maria-l: tagging legal & compliance channels to prepare if customer escalations happen. (reacted :eyes:)
